faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What to know before you create your account.
faq.q1: Do I need a card to try it?
faq.a1_one: No. Creating an account is free and includes {{count}} free visual. You are only asked for a card if you choose a subscription or a pack.
faq.a1_other: No. Creating an account is free and includes {{count}} free visuals. You are only asked for a card if you choose a subscription or a pack.
faq.q2: How long does a visual take?
faq.a2: Between 30 seconds and two minutes. You get a 4:5 image, ready to post on social media.
faq.a3_html: They are sent to Google Cloud (Vertex AI) for the duration of the generation, then kept in your history until you delete them. They are never sold or used for advertising. Privacy policy.
faq.q4: Can I use the generated visuals?
faq.a4_html: Yes. The terms of use grant you usage rights over visuals generated from your own photos, within the limits of Google Cloud's terms. You must hold the rights to the photos you upload and check each visual before publishing it: the AI can alter a detail, such as the text on a pack. Terms of use.
faq.q5: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a5_html: Yes. Subscriptions carry no commitment: you cancel from the Pricing page, and cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid. If you are a consumer, you also have a 14-day right of withdrawal.

final.title: Try it on your own products
final.text: A smartphone photo is enough. Your visual is ready in under two minutes.

s4.p1_html: 4.1 Purpose. {{brand}} generates ad visuals with artificial intelligence from the product photos you upload. Access is by invitation; the publisher may refuse, suspend or close an account at any time, in particular in the event of abuse.
s4.p2_html: 4.2 Your commitments. You certify that you hold the rights required over the photos you upload (products, packaging, brands) and that you will use the generated visuals only in a way that respects trademark owners’ rights. You may not upload unlawful content or photos of identifiable people without their consent, nor attempt to circumvent the quotas and safeguards of the service.
s4.p3_html: 4.3 Generated visuals. Visuals are produced by an AI model: they may contain errors (altered packaging text, missing product, artefacts). You check every visual before publishing it. You hold the usage rights over the visuals generated from your own content, within the limits of the Google Cloud terms of use.
s4.p4_html: 4.4 Quotas and costs. Every generation has a real cost (image model), shown in the studio and counted in your usage. Hourly and daily quotas apply per account. The publisher may change the quotas or start charging for usage after giving prior notice.
s4.p5_html: 4.5 Availability and liability. The service is provided “as is”, with no guarantee of continuous availability or of any particular result. The publisher is not liable for how the visuals are used, nor for indirect damages. Its liability is limited to the amount, if any, paid over the last three months.
s4.p6_html: 4.6 Account security. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential. Report any unauthorised use. The “sign out of all devices” function is available through the API, and changing your password revokes the other sessions.
s4.p7_html: 4.7 Changes. These terms may change; a new version is submitted to you for acceptance at your next sign-in.
s4.p8_html: 4.8 Governing law. Belgian law. In the event of a dispute, the parties shall first attempt to reach an amicable settlement, then the courts of the district where the publisher is established shall have jurisdiction.
s4.title: 4. Terms of use

withdrawal.p1_html: 5.1 Principle. If you are a consumer, you have 14 days from the conclusion of the contract to withdraw, without giving reasons and without penalty.
withdrawal.p2_html: 5.2 Immediate performance and proportionate amount. By subscribing, you expressly request that the service begin immediately, before the end of that period. If you then withdraw, the contract ends but you remain liable for the part already supplied, calculated pro rata of the generations used out of those included in your plan. Example: 60 generations used out of 100, you pay 60% of the price and the balance is refunded to you.
withdrawal.p3_html: 5.3 Visuals already generated. Each delivered visual is digital content already supplied: your right of withdrawal lapses for that visual, which is exactly what the pro rata calculation above expresses.
withdrawal.p4_html: 5.4 Generation packs. A pack bought separately is a distinct contract, with its own 14-day period running from its purchase. Credits still unused are refunded to you.
withdrawal.p5_html: 5.5 How to exercise it. From the Pricing page, which shows the exact amount before confirmation; or by an unambiguous statement sent to the contact address, the form below being available but not mandatory.
withdrawal.p6_html: 5.6 Refund. It is made no later than 14 days after receipt of your decision, using the same means of payment as the original order, at no cost.
withdrawal.p7_html: 5.7 Business customers. The right of withdrawal is reserved for consumers. A purchase made for the purposes of a professional activity does not benefit from it.
withdrawal.title: 5. Right of withdrawal
